analytic.limitations: Known horizontal carriers are an artificial task; false-band/peak metrics quantify residual energy, not a complete hallucination detector. GPU FP16 results are not exact replay of earlier CPU FP32 neural scores. Full photo/real/GFX review remains required.

native_visual_review.interpretation: No clear V55 native advantage. Fine fabric strands remain lost; foliage remains waxy and fence wires soft. Neural fence geometry is more coherent than channel-RawNIND, with no demonstrated improvement from V55. Both carrier examples remain attenuated; flat displays show no obvious new structure. Fixed 8-bit previews cannot exclude low-amplitude false detail. ISO100 is an optical/time reference, not GT.

decision: Stop this candidate at first1000; no promotion or continuation launched. Natural-photo and known-camera means decline, intended weak-carrier response is mixed, and native review shows no clear V55 advantage. Keep optional source default0 and V43 step2000 README reference. Preserve complete checkpoint/optimizer/RNG on original planned4000 schedule. No conclusion of convergence or universal failure of weak-data augmentation.
